data.text:
Inside Sensia Tower Dubai

Exclusive Residences with Unmatched Views

Resort-Style Amenities & Waterfront Luxury

Prime Location: The Heart of Dubai Maritime City

Dubai welcomes yet another architectural marvel, setting new benchmarks in luxury and innovation. With a surge of elite developments reshaping the city’s real estate landscape, one name stands out—BEYOND Developments' Sensia.

This highly anticipated third signature project by the fast-growing developer is the latest addition to the sprawling 8-million-square-foot master-planned community at Dubai Maritime City. Following the remarkable success of Saria and Orise, Sensia Tower Dubai is already generating excitement among investors and homebuyers alike.

Let’s take a deep dive and learn everything revealed about Sensia so far!

Inside Sensia Tower Dubai

Setting a new precedent in luxury living, Sensia Tower Dubai is designed by Hirsch Bedner Associates architecture, a globally acclaimed hospitality design firm. The tower’s unique architectural blueprint incorporates angled floor plates, maximizing privacy while ensuring breathtaking 360-degree views of the Dubai skyline and the Arabian Gulf. This architectural marvel will optimize sunrise-to-sunset panoramas, enhancing the sensory experience of its residents.

Complementing the exterior grandeur, interiors will be meticulously crafted by Design World Partnership (DWP), a firm celebrated for its expertise in luxury hospitality design.

The interiors of BEYOND Developments' Sensia will exude warmth and sophistication, characterized by natural textures and contemporary finishes that elevate the standard of living.

Exclusive Residences with Unmatched Views

Standing 36 stories tall, Sensia Tower Dubai will house 275 premium residences, including:

  • One-bedroom apartments
  • Two-bedroom apartments
  • Three-bedroom apartments
  • Exclusive three-bedroom garden duplexes
  • A signature penthouse with sweeping waterfront views

Each residence will be crafted to offer expansive living spaces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and cutting-edge smart home features. The development’s focus on privacy, comfort, and elegance makes it an irresistible choice for discerning buyers and investors.

Resort-Style Amenities & Waterfront Luxury

BEYOND Developments' Sensia will offer a host of world-class amenities that redefine urban coastal living. The development will be designed to blend urban vibrancy with coastal serenity, ensuring residents experience the best of both worlds. Key amenities include:

  • Waterfront Drop-off & Mediterranean Landscaped Driveways – A grand entrance that immediately sets the tone for an opulent living experience.
  • State-of-the-Art Fitness Facilities – A modern gymnasium, dedicated yoga studios, and outdoor wellness spaces ensure a healthy lifestyle.
  • Lush Landscaped Gardens by the Seaside – Tranquil green spaces designed for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Curated Dining Experiences – Direct access to fine dining options on the ground floor enhances the convenience of luxury living.
  • Vibrant Waterfront Promenade – A lively and picturesque setting for socializing, fitness, and leisure activities.

Prime Location: The Heart of Dubai Maritime City

Strategically located in Maritime City, Sensia Tower Dubai will enjoy close proximity to major attractions and business hubs, ensuring a seamless lifestyle for residents. The key highlights of its location include:

  • 10 minutes to Jumeirah’s beaches
  • 15 minutes to Downtown Dubai’s business and entertainment district
  • Effortless connectivity to major highways and transportation hubs

This premium location offers residents the perfect blend of urban convenience and waterfront tranquility, making it one of the most desirable addresses in Dubai.

Why Should You Consider Investing in Sensia?

The launch of BEYOND Developments' Sensia aligns with the Dubai Real Estate Sector Strategy 2033. The overwhelming investor confidence in Saria and Orise has translated into remarkable anticipation for Sensia Tower Dubai, reinforcing BEYOND Developments' rapid growth and reputation for delivering visionary projects.

faqs.question: What makes Sensia Tower Dubai unique?

data.answer: Sensia Tower Dubai stands out with its distinctive Hirsch Bedner Associates architecture, featuring angled floor plates for enhanced privacy and panoramic views. It offers an exclusive selection of luxury residences complemented by world-class amenities and a prime waterfront location.

faqs.question: What types of residences are available at Sensia Tower Dubai?

data.answer: The development includes one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, exclusive three-bedroom garden duplexes, and a signature penthouse with breathtaking waterfront views.

faqs.question: When is Sensia Tower Dubai expected to be completed?

data.answer: The tower is anticipated to be completed by Q1 2029, offering a premium living experience for residents and investors alike.

faqs.question: What amenities are available at Sensia Tower Dubai?

data.answer: Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gymnasium, yoga studios, landscaped gardens, waterfront drop-off, Mediterranean driveways, curated dining experiences, and a vibrant waterfront promenade.

faqs.question: Where is Sensia Tower Dubai located?

data.answer: Sensia Tower Dubai is strategically located in Dubai Maritime City, just 10 minutes from Jumeirah’s beaches and 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai.
